nodes.name: Every Monday 8 AM
nodes.notes: Fires at 08:00 UTC every Monday. Adjust the cron expression to match your team's timezone — e.g. '0 7 * * 1' for BST.

nodes.name: Fetch At-Risk Accounts
nodes.notes: Calls the Python scoring API. Set SCORING_API_URL in your n8n environment variables, e.g. http://localhost:5678

nodes.name: Any Accounts Flagged?
nodes.notes: True branch → generate and post digest. False branch → post 'all clear' message.

nodes.name: Build LLM Prompt
nodes.notes: Formats the account list into a prompt for Claude. Change the model name in llmPayload if you prefer a different Anthropic model.

nodes.name: Generate Alert Text
nodes.notes: Calls Anthropic Messages API. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in n8n environment variables. If you prefer OpenAI, replace URL and payload format.

nodes.name: Build Slack Blocks
nodes.notes: Parses the LLM output and formats it into Slack Block Kit. Adjust the emoji thresholds (65/40) or bar characters to match your team's preferences.

nodes.name: Post Digest to Slack
nodes.notes: Posts to a Slack Incoming Webhook. Set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in n8n environment variables. Create a webhook at api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: '✅ *Churn Risk Digest — ' + new Date().toDateString() + '*\n\nNo accounts cleared the risk threshold this week. All 390 active accounts are below the alert level. See you next Monday.' }) }}

nodes.name: Post All-Clear to Slack
nodes.notes: Sent on the 'no accounts' branch so the CS team gets confirmation the workflow ran, even on quiet weeks.
